metadata.Name: Russian-Language Multimodal Dataset for Automatic Summarization of Scientific Papers
metadata.Description: The dataset is a multimodal collection of Russian-language scientific papers designed for automatic text summarization. It includes texts, tables, and figures, covering 7 scientific domains with 420 papers.
Provider: A.P. Ershov Institute of Informatics Systems
metadata.Paper Title: Russian-Language Multimodal Dataset for Automatic Summarization of Scientific Papers
Affiliations: A.P. Ershov Institute of Informatics Systems, Russia
metadata.Abstract: The paper discusses the creation of a multimodal dataset of Russian-language scientific papers and testing of existing language models for the task of automatic text summarization. A feature of the dataset is its multimodal data, which includes texts, tables and figures. The paper presents the results of experiments with two language models: Gigachat from SBER and YandexGPT from Yandex. The dataset consists of 420 papers and is publicly available on https://github.com/iisresearch-team/summarization-dataset.
